2. Type D Power Generating Modules shall fulfil the following requirements referring to Voltage
stability:
a) With regard to Voltage ranges:
1) While still respecting the provisions according to Articles 9(3) (a) and 11(3) (a), a Power
Generating Module shall be capable of staying connected to the Network and operating
within the ranges of the Network Voltage at the Connection Point, expressed by the
Voltage at the Connection Point related to nominal Voltage (per unit), and the time
periods specified by tables 6.1 and 6.2.
